instruction: Candid medium shot of a wedding ceremony indoors. Seated on the right, the bride in the light green saree (R1) smiles joyfully while wearing a pink lotus garland. Leaning from the left, the groom in the silver shirt (R2), also wearing a lotus garland, kisses her cheek. In the background, the older woman in the blue saree (R3) smiles on the left, and the man in the black shirt (R4) stands looking on. Two blurred bystanders stand in the background. Warm stage lighting illuminates the scene decorated with purple drapes.
elements: R2 leans in and kisses R1's cheek
R1 is the seated cheek-kiss recipient while R2 is the active kisser
R3 and R4 remain background onlookers rather than participating in the kiss
R1 wears a pink lotus garland
R2 also wears a lotus garland
the scene is an indoor wedding ceremony with purple drapes
